steps.name: apt_souffle
steps.cmd: set -e; apt-get update -qq; apt-get install -y -qq wget gnupg ca-certificates; wget -q https://souffle-lang.github.io/ppa/souffle-key.public -O /usr/share/keyrings/souffle-archive-keyring.gpg; echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/souffle-archive-keyring.gpg] https://souffle-lang.github.io/ppa/ubuntu/ stable main' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/souffle.list; apt-get update -qq; apt-get install -y -qq souffle; souffle --version
